object.attr: HeartRateMeasurementTest.strap not worn suppresses the reading
object.description: Expected: A Heart Rate Measurement with sensor contact reported as not detected yields no bpm, and a value of 0 bpm yields no bpm (companion test: HeartRateMeasurementTest.zero bpm is treated as no reading). This proves the BLE parser only; the ANT+ path and the displayed result are covered by PACE-STS-67.
